name: Cridhe
description: The plane whose isle is plunged into generations of winter and darkness.

description_citations.text: "The Cursed Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos gives Nohr Soulslayer and Nohr swears to break the tree to gain planeswalkerhood.
timeline.quote: Nohr swore to break the tree to gain planeswalkerhood .

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nohr splits the Clan Tree despite Haen's protests, causing the Parting and killing the tree.
timeline.quote: Despite Haen's heavy protesting, Nohr split the tree, causing Haen to fall out of its branches to the ground

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haen sleeps frozen in time, then wakes three weeks later with fire in his fingers and reawakens the tree's remnants with a new ritual.
timeline.quote: Haen woke up and had a fire in his fingers

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nohr confronts Haen and destroys the Clan Tree with Soulslayer, breaking the sword tip into his own chest.
timeline.quote: When Haen refuses to reveal the mana line, Nohr lashes out at the tree with the sword, sending out a freezing beam that causes the Clan Tree to explode into icy chunks.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith is nearly devoured by a shroud on the march.
timeline.quote: On the march to Inys Nohr, Aylith is nearly devoured by a shroud

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The capture of Aylith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith heals Nazir's madness; they recite the ritual and the Clan Tree is mended.
timeline.quote: A small sapling Clan Tree arises and the plane's balance is restored.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos is consumed by a shroud disguised as a tent after Tempé visits him.
timeline.quote: which lulls him to sleep with a magical song and then collapses upon him, consuming him.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The death of Malvos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crephas engineers the Albions with an altered fungus to work his coal mines, and they become addicted and turn blue.
timeline.quote: He served the altered fungus to his best soldiers, increasing their capacity for work and their ability to see in near darkness.

citation.text: "Human", section "Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crephas chooses to enslave the Mirkalbions, binding them to himself.
timeline.quote: He chose to enslave them, binding them to himself.

citation.text: "Human", section "Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos steals Tempé's mana as payment and is exiled to Cridhe, marked with snake tattoos that would kill him if he thought of touching mana.
timeline.quote: Malvos stole Tempé's mana as payment for his services.

citation.text: "Malvos", section "Imprisonment on Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Cridhe Malvos discovers the hidden Clan Tree and plans to make someone a planeswalker with its mana.
timeline.quote: he found an enormous source of mana hidden even from Planeswalkers' eyes

citation.text: "Malvos", section "Imprisonment on Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos gives Nohr the sword Soulslayer; the magical rays miss the mana line and destroy the Clan Tree, causing the Parting.
timeline.quote: the Clan Tree was destroyed, causing the Parting

citation.text: "Malvos", section "Imprisonment on Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crippled after the Mending, Malvos is visited by Tempé, tells her what he knows, and is devoured by a hungry shroud.
timeline.quote: collapsing around him, devouring him whole

citation.text: "Malvos", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi recruits Wrenn on Cridhe to fight the Phyrexians; the group gathers on Dominaria and settles in Urza's Tower.
timeline.quote: Wrenn was recruited by Teferi to join the fight against the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Instigated by Malvos, Nohr destroys the Clan Tree trying to become a planeswalker; the isle splits in two and Nohr and his descendants are cursed with madness.
timeline.quote: the wizard Nohr destroyed the tree trying to become a planeswalker

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Parting, clouds obscure the sun and the climate collapses; crops wither and Nohrland dies.
timeline.quote: Clouds immediately obscured the sun, creating a permanent daily twilight and nightly darkness.

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Year 520, Aylith and Nazir mend the Clan Tree and the seasons return to normal.
timeline.quote: Keeper Aylith and Felonarch Nazir descendants of Haen and Nohr, mended the Clan Tree .

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith breaks the curse on Nazir and together they recreate the Clan Tree from the last acorn, fulfilling Haen's prophecy.
timeline.quote: the Keeper Aylith used her powers to break the curse on Nazir .

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir has a prophetic vision of what the plane will look like in 1000 years.
timeline.quote: the healed wizard Nazir had a prophetic vision of what the plane would look like 1000 years in the future

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Cridhe was created by a being called the Maker

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: residence of the Heanish (the descendants of Haen ) in the central mountainous region

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "Geography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
